findings.message: Failed-probe diagnostic output (hc_snippet, up to 500 chars) is written only to the markdown summary; the structured result JSON carries data:{} — any downstream consumer or alert that previously read 'detail' or 'rc' from validate-result.json now gets nothing, silently.

The error artifact on missing state_file is written only when ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR is set; if that env var is absent the broken-disposition path produces no structured artifact, leaving the failure unobservable to any result-scraping consumer.

A valid but structurally wrong stage-inputs.json (no .inputs.deploy_result key) causes jq to return empty and the stage to fail as 'missing required input' — a new silent failure mode with no event emitted and no distinction from a truly absent file.

Return-code normalization (rc 2→1) removes the only signal that distinguished engine-contract violations from probe failures at the exit-code level; any caller or CI step that branched on rc==2 will silently lose that distinction with no migration path.
